title: Feature Spectrum Learning for Remote Sensing Change Detection

layout.note: Five lettered columns divided by dotted vertical lines: three narrow ones (a)-(c) with a top image, a method box and a bottom image, then a wide (d) split by a dotted horizontal line into two drawbacks, then (e) with the proposed method.

lesson: Diagnose in lettered panels: show the same photos under each earlier method with coloured boxes on the failure regions, give each remaining drawback its own red-cross heading and a tiny schematic, then answer both in the last panel and end with a tick list.
